title: Bypass Pruning Shears with SK5 Steel Blade and Safety Lock
description:
Sharp, comfortable secateurs for roses, shrubs, fruit trees and deadheading flowers.
• Bypass blade in SK5 carbon steel, cuts branches up to 20 mm
• Non-stick coated blades with a sap groove
• Ergonomic soft-grip handles and a strong return spring
• One-hand safety lock; length 20 cm

title: Garden Hand Tool Set 3-Piece: Trowel, Transplanter and Hand Fork
description:
Rust-resistant hand tools for planting bulbs, potting up seedlings and loosening soil in beds and containers.
• Wide trowel, narrow transplanter with depth markings and 3-prong hand fork
• Polished stainless steel heads
• Hardwood handles with hanging holes
• Length approx. 30 cm each

title: Bypass Loppers 70 cm for Branches up to 40 mm
description:
Long-handled loppers that give extra reach and leverage for thick branches in hedges, shrubs and fruit trees.
• Hardened steel bypass blades for clean cuts up to 40 mm
• Lightweight aluminium handles, 70 cm overall length
• Shock-absorbing bumpers and soft-grip handles
• Blade guard included for safe storage

title: Ceramic Plant Pots, Set of 2 with Drainage Holes and Saucers
description:
Clean, modern pots for houseplants, herbs and succulents, in one white and one black glazed finish.
• Sizes: Ø 15 × 13 cm and Ø 12 × 11 cm
• Glazed ceramic with a soft matte finish
• Drainage hole with rubber plug and matching saucer
• For indoor use and sheltered balconies

title: Hanging Flower Basket 30 cm with Coco Liner and Chain
description:
Classic hanging basket for trailing petunias, fuchsias, strawberries and herbs on porches, pergolas and balconies.
• Diameter 30 cm, black powder-coated steel wire frame
• Natural coconut fibre liner holds moisture and lets excess water drain
• 3-arm chain with hook, hanging length about 45 cm
• Replaceable liner

title: Wooden Raised Garden Bed 120 × 60 × 30 cm
description:
Raised bed for growing vegetables, herbs and flowers at a comfortable working height, with soil that warms up early in spring.
• Outer size 120 × 60 × 30 cm, holds about 200 L of soil
• Pressure-treated pine boards with corner posts
• Open bottom; weed membrane liner included
• Slot-together assembly, no tools needed

title: Aluminium Wind Chime with 6 Tubes, 80 cm
description:
Wind chime with six tuned aluminium tubes that ring out calm, deep tones in the slightest breeze.
• Overall length approx. 80 cm, tubes 30–55 cm
• Anodised aluminium tubes with wooden striker and wind sail
• Strong nylon cord and hanging ring
• Weather-resistant for gardens, balconies and porches

title: Garden Gnome Figurines, Set of 2, Hand-Painted Resin
description:
Cheerful gnomes that bring colour and a bit of fun to flower beds, rockeries, balconies and garden steps.
• Set of 2, each approx. 20 cm tall
• Weather-resistant polyresin with hand-painted details
• UV-stable paint that resists fading
• Flat base for stable standing outdoors or indoors

title: Folding Bistro Set 3-Piece: Round Table and 2 Chairs, Powder-Coated Steel
description:
Space-saving metal bistro set for balconies, small patios and garden corners that folds flat for winter storage.
• Table Ø 60 cm, height 71 cm; chairs 41 × 49 × 82 cm
• Powder-coated steel frame resists rust
• Each chair supports up to 110 kg
• Delivered fully assembled

title: Parachute Nylon Hammock with Tree Straps, Holds up to 200 kg
description:
Light, packable hammock for the garden, camping and festivals that sets up between two trees in minutes.
• Size 270 × 140 cm, breathable 210T parachute nylon
• Holds up to 200 kg
• Includes 2 tree straps with 10 loops each and 2 steel carabiners
• Packs into an attached pouch; weighs 650 g

title: Patio Parasol 2.7 m with Crank and Tilt
description:
Large market-style parasol that shades a dining table for 4–6 people on patios, decks and terraces.
• Canopy Ø 270 cm in 180 g/m² polyester with a UV-resistant, fade-resistant coating
• Crank opening and push-button tilt
• Powder-coated steel pole Ø 38 mm with 8 ribs and an air vent
• Base not included; fits stands for 38 mm poles

title: Garden Hose 20 m with Wall Hanger, Connectors and Spray Gun
description:
Complete watering set for gardens, balconies and washing the car, ready to connect to an outside tap.
• 20 m reinforced PVC hose, 13 mm (1/2 inch) inner diameter, kink-resistant
• 7-pattern spray gun with lockable trigger
• Tap adaptor, quick connectors and hose stop
• Steel wall hanger with screws

title: Galvanised Metal Watering Can 5 L with Removable Rose
description:
Traditional watering can for flower beds, pots and greenhouse plants, made to last for years outdoors.
• Capacity 5 L
• Hot-dip galvanised steel, rust-resistant
• Removable rose for a gentle shower, or pour directly from the spout
• Balanced top and rear handles for easy pouring

title: Rotating Lawn Sprinkler with 3 Arms, Covers up to 113 m²
description:
Rotating sprinkler that waters lawns, vegetable plots and flower beds evenly in a full circle.
• Spray radius adjustable up to 6 m (about 113 m²)
• 3 adjustable arms with nozzles for fine or coarse spray
• Stable weighted base with ground spike
• Standard click connector for 13 mm (1/2 inch) hoses

title: Charcoal Kettle Barbecue 47 cm with Lid and Ash Catcher
description:
Classic round kettle grill for juicy burgers, sausages and vegetables; close the lid to roast and smoke as well.
• Cooking grate Ø 47 cm, chrome-plated steel
• Enamelled bowl and lid with adjustable air vents and lid thermometer
• Ash catcher and wheels for easy moving
• Height approx. 90 cm

title: BBQ Tool Set 5-Piece, Stainless Steel, with Storage Case
description:
Long-handled grill tools that keep your hands away from the heat while turning, basting and serving.
• Tongs, spatula with bottle opener, grill fork, basting brush and grill cleaning brush
• Brushed stainless steel, 40–45 cm long
• Heat-resistant handles with hanging loops
• Zipped storage case

title: Hanging Bird Seed Feeder with 4 Ports and Perches
description:
Clear tube feeder for sunflower hearts and mixed seed that lets you watch finches, tits and sparrows up close.
• Height 30 cm, holds about 600 g of seed
• 4 feeding ports with metal perches
• UV-resistant polycarbonate tube with metal lid and base
• Lid lifts off for easy filling and cleaning

title: Wooden Bird House Nest Box with Hanging Cord
description:
Small wooden nest box that gives tits, sparrows and other small garden birds a safe place to raise their young.
• Size approx. 15 × 13 × 22 cm, entrance hole Ø 32 mm
• Solid fir wood with weatherproof water-based stain
• Removable side panel for cleaning at the end of the season
• Hanging cord and screw eye included; can also be wall-mounted

title: Polytunnel Greenhouse 3 × 2 m with Roll-Up Door and Windows
description:
Walk-in tunnel greenhouse that extends the growing season for tomatoes, peppers, cucumbers and seedlings.
• Size 300 × 200 × 200 cm (L × W × H)
• Reinforced PE cover with roll-up zip door and 4 ventilation windows
• Galvanised steel tube frame, Ø 19 mm
• Ground pegs and guy ropes included

title: Seed Starter Kit: 3 Trays with 36 Cells Each and Humidity Domes
description:
Start vegetables, herbs and flowers indoors weeks before the outdoor season begins.
• 3 trays with 36 cells each (108 cells in total)
• Clear humidity domes with adjustable vents
• Reusable BPA-free plastic
• Plant labels and a dibber included
